# solo

## Plugin reference

- Description: Solo (fullscreen) surface mode — the default boot mode: only the focused tab, full-viewport (the tab bar and app rail hidden, the global action bar floating). Left only through the surface-mode control (no keyboard shortcut: Esc belongs to whatever is open).
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Surface.Placement` "Fullscreen (solo)"
  - Uses: `apps-core/surface.Surface`
